description:
#### **Job Title:** **Human Resources – Talent Acquisition specialist (Hotel Industry)**

* Internship
* Fresher
* Junior
* Senior

#### **Job Brief: Human Resources –** **Talent acquisition specialist** **(recruitment)**

* We are looking for Human resources – talent acquisition executive, recruiter, from hotel/restaurant industry who can handle talent acquisition (recruitment) responsibilities.
* A Talent Acquisition Specialist is responsible for sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent to fill various roles within the organisation, from entry-level to managerial positions.
* This position focuses on understanding the unique needs of the outlets, finding the best-fit candidates, and promoting a strong employer brand to attract and retain quality employees.
* The Talent Acquisition Specialist plays an essential role in helping the organisation attract quality talent, contributing to its success and positive guest experience by maintaining a skilled and motivated workforce.

#### **Department:**

* Operations – Human Resources

**Job Type:**

* Full time
* Part time

**Type of Company:** **Hotel Industry**

* Hotels & Resorts
* Restaurants & Bars

**Work mode:**

* Hybrid

* **Note:**

* We do not have complete work from home option.
* Hybrid mode of work means: Work from office (minimum two days a week) – work from home – as per the requirement.
* Hybrid mode of work can be changed to full time work from office as per the work requirement.

**Work Location:**

* MBP, Mahape, Navi Mumbai

**Interview Location:**

* MBP, Mahape, Navi Mumbai

**Shift Timings:**

* 10.00 AM to 07.00 PM

**Working:**

* 5 days working
* 2 day Holiday
* Rotational Holidays

**Experience:**

* Minimum – Intern / Fresher
* Maximum – Up to 9 years of experience as human resources – talent acquisition specialist from hotel/restaurant industry can apply.

* **Note:**

* Candidate having relevant experience from hotel industry would be considered.

**Salary slab:**

* Internship – Rs.120,000/- Per annum (CTC / Fix + Variable = 80:20 ration)
* Fresher – Rs.180,000/- Per annum (CTC / Fix + Variable = 80:20 ration)
* Experience – up to Rs.900,000/- Per annum (CTC / Fix + Variable = 80:20 ration)

* **Note:**

* Salary structure: Fix + Variable (80:20 ratio).
* Candidates applying for the above post should be compulsory target oriented, as offered salary will be target oriented.
* Candidates applying for the above post should have their own laptop, good internet connection.
* Some weekend or evening work may be required depending on recruitment events or urgent hiring needs.

**Education qualification:**

* HR certification (e.g., PHR, SHRM-CP).
* Knowledge of industry-specific roles, including back-of-house (e.g., cooks, dishwashers) and front-of-house (e.g., servers, hosts) positions.
* Experience in a high-volume, fast-paced environment such as the restaurant industry.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, hotel management or related field.
* Master of Business Administration in HR/Management/Hospitality
* Diploma / Graduate in Travel and tourism (any related certification would be added benefit)
* BHM – Bachelor of Hotel Management (any related certification would be added benefit)

**Job Description:**

The Talent Acquisition Specialist will lead the recruitment process for the outlets, ensuring that all hiring needs are met efficiently and effectively. They work closely with hiring managers to understand staffing requirements, utilise creative sourcing methods to attract candidates, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new hires. This role requires deep knowledge of the hospitality industry, a strong network of talent, and the ability to promote a positive brand image.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Recruitment Strategy and Planning

* Sourcing and Candidate Attraction

* Candidate Screening and Selection

* Employer Branding

* Onboarding and Orientation

* Compliance and Record-Keeping

* Data Analysis and Reporting

* Relationship Management

**Key Responsibilities**:

**Recruitment Strategy and Planning:**

* Develop and implement recruitment strategies tailored to the restaurant industry, with a focus on attracting quality candidates for both front-of-house and back-of-house positions.
* Collaborate with managers to forecast staffing needs, considering seasonal trends and business growth.
* Analyse hiring trends and adjust recruitment strategies to meet changing demands.

**Sourcing and Candidate Attraction:**

* Utilise various sourcing channels, including job boards, social media, career fairs, community events, and employee referrals to reach diverse candidate pools.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for high-turnover positions typical in the hospitality industry, such as servers, cooks, hosts, waiters, front desk, housekeeping, kitchen staff, etc.
* Foster relationships with local culinary schools, hospitality programs, and industry associations to attract talent.

**Candidate Screening and Selection:**

* Review resumes, conduct initial screenings, and shortlist candidates based on qualifications and fit for the environment.
* Schedule and conduct interviews, assess technical skills, cultural fit, and customer service orientation.
* Collaborate with hiring managers on final candidate selection, considering both operational needs and team dynamics.

**Employer Branding:**

* Promote the brand to position it as an employer of choice in the industry.
* Work with marketing or HR teams to create engaging job advertisements and content for social media that showcases the restaurant’s work culture, growth opportunities, and employee benefits.
* Represent the restaurant at career fairs, industry events, and community gatherings to boost brand visibility and attract talent.

**Onboarding and Orientation:**

* Coordinate with the HR and operations teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new hires, including orientation and training.
* Develop onboarding materials that familiarise new employees with the organisation culture, standards, and expectations.
* Gather feedback from new hires to improve the onboarding process continually.

**Compliance and Record-Keeping:**

* Ensure all hiring practices comply with local, state, and federal employment laws, including EEO, FMLA, and ADA.
* Maintain accurate records of candidates, job postings, and interviews in the applicant tracking system (ATS).
* Handle candidate background checks, references, and pre-employment verifications as needed.

**Data Analysis and Reporting:**

* Track and analyse key recruitment metrics, such as time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, and candidate sources.
* Provide regular reports to HR management on recruiting performance, trends, and areas for improvement.
* Use data to optimise recruitment strategies and reduce turnover rates.

**Relationship Management:**

* Build and maintain relationships with hiring managers and other leaders to stay informed on departmental needs.
* Serve as a point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring process, ensuring clear communication and a positive candidate experience.
* Develop partnerships with staffing agencies and recruitment vendors as necessary for high-volume hiring.

**Key Competencies:**

* **Proactivity**: Ability to anticipate hiring needs and act quickly to build a talent pool.
* **Creativity**: Develop innovative sourcing methods to attract candidates in a competitive market.
* **Resilience**: Able to handle high-volume recruiting demands and manage multiple roles simultaneously.
* **Customer Service Orientation**: Focused on delivering a positive experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Key Skills:**

* Good knowledge and understanding about staff requirements.

* Good knowledge and understanding of recruitment.

* Well-organised and detail-oriented.

* Must be able to multi-task and take instruction from many sources.

* Strong interpersonal skills

* Positive attitude.

* Target oriented

* Presentable Personality

* Attention to detail

* Marketing skills

* Communication skills

* Relationship building skills

* Multitasking skills

* Time management skills

* Patience

* Listening skills

**Core Skills:**

* Knowledge of employment laws and best practices in recruitment and selection.
* Knowledge of human resources procedures

* Ability to operate office equipment (fax, copier, mail, etc.)

* Human resources Recruitment experience

* Ability to type at least 40 words per minute

* Proficient in proofreading, spelling, grammar punctuation and math

**Advanced Skills:**

* Knowledge of lead generation

* Proficient with data management

* Familiarity with social media

**Creative Skills:**

* Excellent verbal & written communication skills.

* Excellent grasp of English language.

* Creative & innovative thinker & planner.

**Management Skills:**

* Ability to work both independently & as an active member of a team.

* Able to prioritise, & manage time efficiently.

* Managing different projects simultaneously & working with strict deadlines.

* Self-motivated & self-directed.

**IT Skills:**

* Expertise in word processing, database, and spreadsheet software, including Microsoft office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, & Excel) & Google Docs.
* Ability to learn new and updated software
* Familiarity with recruiting software and applicant tracking systems (ATS).

**Job Description:**

**About ETS:**

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.

Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

**About ETS: Advancing Measurement to Power Human Progress**
------------------------------------------------------------

Educational Testing Service (ETS) is a global education and talent solutions organization committed to helping learners thrive in a rapidly changing world. For **more than 75 years**, ETS has advanced the **science of measurement**, setting global standards for **fair, valid, and reliable assessment across cultures, languages, and borders**.

ETS is best known for world‑class assessments such as **TOEFL®**, **TOEIC®**, **GRE®**, and **Praxis®**, serving millions of learners annually in **more than 200 countries and territories**. Through strategic acquisitions-including **PSI**, **Edusoft**, **Kira Talent**, **Pipplet**, **Vericant**, and **Wheebox**-ETS has expanded its capabilities across **education, workforce, and digital assessment ecosystems**.

Through the **ETS Research Institute** and **ETS Solutions**, we partner with **governments, education systems, institutions, and employers** to strengthen learning outcomes, promote equity and mobility, and enable lifelong learning at scale. With offices and partners across **Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas**, ETS delivers **nearly 50 million assessments annually**, supporting evidence‑based decision‑making worldwide.

In India, ETS plays a growing and strategic role in **large‑scale education assessment, policy‑aligned measurement, and capacity building**, working closely with public‑sector and system‑level stakeholders.

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Monitoring, Evaluation & Data Analytics Specialist will lead state project's work on monitoring, evaluation, data management, and analytics to support implementation of the Assessment Excellence & Item Bank Institutionalization, Holistic Progress Card (HPC), and SQAAF initiatives in Haryana. The role will support data collection, test administration, data analysis and interpretation, implementation monitoring, assessment analytics, and data-driven decision-making across all project components. The specialist will work closely with SCERT, BSEH, district officials, technical partners, and ETS experts to strengthen data systems, generate actionable insights, and support continuous improvement and institutionalization of reform initiatives.

**Location Requirement:**

This role may require relocation to a designated location within North India, based on project requirements. Flexibility to relocate and work from the assigned location is required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead development of data management systems, dashboards foresightedness, and reporting solutions to support real-time monitoring of assessment reforms, HPC pilot implementation, capacity-building activities, and SQAAF initiatives.
* Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of assessment, training, implementation, and monitoring data to identify trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Plan for integration of assessment, monitoring, and implementation data with state MIS/EMIS platforms and other digital systems, ensuring data interoperability, quality, and sustainability.
* Design governance structures, accountability mechanisms, roles and responsibilities for SQAAF implementation and plan for future automated dashboards and visualization tools for state, district, block, and school-level stakeholders to facilitate evidence-based decision-making.
* Establish data quality assurance, validation, storage, privacy, and governance protocols aligned with national and international standards. Develop institutional operating model and reporting architecture.
* Design monitoring tools, survey instruments, trackers, scorecards, and evaluation methodologies for pilot implementation, capacity building, school quality monitoring, and reform initiatives.
* Generate analytical reports, policy briefs, learning notes, and evidence summaries to support programme reviews, stakeholder consultations, and strategic decision-making.
* Support impact assessments, pilot evaluations, readiness studies, diagnostic reviews, and validation exercises across Assessment Excellence, HPC, and SQAAF components.
* Build capacity of state officials and project stakeholders on data utilization, dashboard interpretation, evidence-based planning, monitoring practices, and continuous improvement mechanisms.

**#LI-SL1**  
**Experience and Skills:**

**Knowledge & Skills**
----------------------

* Strong understanding of Monitoring & Evaluation frameworks, Results Frameworks, Theory of Change, and education sector performance indicators.
* Knowledge of educational assessment data, learning outcome measurement, and programme evaluation methodologies.
* Experience working with MIS/EMIS platforms, data integration systems, and digital monitoring solutions.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills, including survey design, data analysis, and interpretation.
* Knowledge of data governance, privacy, information security, and quality assurance practices.
* Excellent analytical, report-writing, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience in data analytics, statistical analysis, dashboard development, and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or equivalent) is preferable, not mandatorily required.
* Proficiency in data management and statistical tools such as SPSS, R, Python, STATA, or equivalent.

**Education**
-------------

**Post-Graduate degree in Management/ Economics / Statistics or equivalent in other disciplines**  

**Experience**
--------------

* Minimum 5 years of experience in monitoring and evaluation of large-scale programs in the social sector, preferably in education.
* Experience generating evidence, evaluation findings, and analytical insights to inform policy and programme improvement.
* Demonstrated experience in data systems, dashboards, and digital platforms for programme monitoring.
* Experience in working with government education systems (state or national level) preferred.

**Why Join ETS in India**
-------------------------

* Contribute to **high‑impact education and assessment initiatives** that shape learning outcomes at scale.
* Be part of a **mission‑driven, research‑led organization** with global credibility and public purpose.
* Work at the intersection of **policy, research, and large‑scale implementation**.

* Access professional growth opportunities supported by **Business Resource Groups (BRGs)** and learning communities.
* As a not‑for‑profit, ETS encourages social impact-employees may be eligible for **additional paid volunteer time**.

title: Associate Marketing Recruiter | Tamatar Talent
description:
Our Mission

**Tamatar Talent** helps mission-driven, boldly ambitious startups - the ones trying to solve problems that matter, the ones who should win - build their internal marketing, brand, and creative teams. We're an early-stage recruitment marketing firm, and we're building this from zero.

We're looking for someone to be that zero-to-one partner with us: someone who can recruit for marketing roles with real market fluency, real hustle, and real judgment - someone who enables founders to build a much stronger brand by finding them the right marketing talent.

What you'll do

* Talk to founders and brand leaders directly - understand not just what they're asking for, but what they actually need, by asking the right questions and reading between the lines.
* Scout and reach out to candidates on LinkedIn, at volume - this is a manual, high-touch process, and the more organized you are (and the smarter you use AI to help), the further you'll get.
* Use your own judgment to call whether someone's a real fit - for the role and for the business behind it. You'll need to put yourself in the founder's shoes.
* Shortlist candidates, manage the pipeline, and keep communication instant - same-day replies to clients and candidates, always. No one waits two days to hear back from you.
* Close the gap between what a client wants and what a candidate wants - get both sides to yes, without overselling either one.
* Schedule and prep everyone for calls, interviews, and conversations - meticulously.
* Build relationships for the long term, not just the placement - a candidate who isn't right for one role today might be exactly right for something six months from now.
* Help build the processes and systems for how this team recruits - from the ground up, alongside us.

Who we're looking for

**Marketing hiring experience.** You've done non-tech hiring before, mostly for brand, marketing, or GTM roles. You know what "good" looks like in a marketing hire, not just what a job description says.

**Real marketing fluency.** You understand the jargon that comes with the territory, B2B included, and you can tell the difference between what a B2B tech marketer does versus a consumer brand-side marketer, an agency-side digital marketer, and an SEO. You keep track of where the marketing landscape is moving, not just where it's been.

**A consultative seller, not a pusher.** You can convince a brand why a candidate is right, and a candidate why a role is right - but only because you've actually figured out what they need. Sales, to us, means counseling: asking the right question at the right time, never talking someone into the wrong thing.

**AI-fluent.** You already use tools like Claude and Cowork to move faster, and you want to keep getting better at that.

**A real networker.** You're a people person who doesn't run out of energy after talking to 50 people in a day. You want to build a strong network among marketers and brand builders - and you genuinely understand what marketing does for a brand, not just how to source for it.

**Early in your career, but strong and ambitious.** You want to build something real from the ground up, not just execute a job description.

**Organized, prompt, and meticulous.** You read between the lines in a conversation instead of just replying to it. You keep things in order because you genuinely care about being organized, not because someone's checking.

**Curious about how businesses are built.** You want to learn how teams, brands, and companies come together, and you see every client relationship as a chance to learn that.

**A fast learner who solves before you escalate.** In the age of AI, when you're stuck, your first call is to AI and to yourself, not to whoever on the team is closest - you don't disrupt the whole team's flow before you've tried to figure it out. You'll get plenty of feedback when you get things wrong, and that's fine - you're not expected to be scared of mistakes. Own them, be able to explain the call you made and why, and use that to grow faster.

The practical bits

* **Location:** Hybrid, based out of Bangalore.
* **Engagement:** Full-time preferred; open to the right person on a contract or freelance basis.
* **Timeline:** We're in no rush. We're looking for the right person, not the fastest hire

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

description:
**Description: Senior Expense Accountant**  
  
**The Opportunity** Are you a detail-oriented, highly analytical finance professional with deep experience in expense reimbursement operations, international disbursements, and month-end accounting? We are looking for a Senior Expense Accountant to drive our operational expense accounting and payment processes across our 50+ international entities. You will manage end-to-end expense operations, lead banking disbursements, post critical month-end accruals, and resolve advanced escalations. By partnering cross-functionally with HR, Tax, Payroll, and Audit teams, you will play a key role in strengthening operational excellence, elevating the employee experience, and maintaining world-class financial controls in a dynamic global environment.  
  
**About the Team** As an integral member of the international expense operations team supporting EMEA and APAC, you will report directly to the International Expense Manager. Our team culture emphasizes collaboration, accountability, and continuous process improvement. You will step into a hybrid work setup, working in the Bangalore office a minimum of three days a week to enable close partnership with stakeholders while maintaining flexibility. With minimal travel requirements, you can stay focused on day-to-day accounting operations, payment integrity, and regional close priorities.  
  
**Your Role**

* **Expense Operations & Escalations:** Review/approve/reimburse expense reports in your assigned entities. Manage high-volume regional shared inboxes (International/India), categorizing and resolving employee inquiries, Expensify workflow escalations, and system-generated report actions.
* **Mentorship & Team Leadership:** Act as the senior subject matter expert on the floor. Serve as an escalation point and mentor, providing internal guidance, clarification, and training to junior team members on complex policy interpretations.
* **Banking & Disbursements:** Establish and distribute monthly payment schedules. Own, audit, and update the global repository of 1,600+ bank templates for evolving banking standards. Prepare, upload, and route international entity and India payment files for designated managerial approvals. Own, audit, and update the global repository of 1,600+ bank templates for evolving banking standards.
* **Process Improvement:** Actively research, test, and implement direct upload methods and system enhancements to eliminate manual banking templates and streamline global payment architecture.
* **Month-End Close & Financial Reporting:** Calculate and post month-end expense accruals and expense journals for international and India entities.
* **Policy Compliance & HR Investigations:** Interpret complex expense policy questions, evaluate exceptions and seek necessary exception approvals, and review final expense claim settlements for resigning personnel. Partner closely with HR to investigate audit flags, unusual activity, and policy breaches.
* **Cross-Functional & Audit Collaboration:** Facilitate statutory audit readiness by working directly with international external auditors and India Statutory Auditors on documentation requests. Coordinate with International Tax for Corporate Income Tax (CIT) filings, and partner with International Payroll to furnish accurate data for statutory filings.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline; CA Inter, CMA, or CPA coursework preferred.
* 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with a substantial focus on expense operations, travel & entertainment (T&E) accounting, and corporate disbursements in a multinational environment.
* Expert-level Microsoft Excel skills (advanced nested formulas, XLOOKUP, PivotTables, Power Query, dynamic arrays, and large-scale data manipulation).
* Proven hands-on experience handling electronic banking platforms, batch payment preparation, multi-currency disbursements, and complex banking template maintenance.
* Solid working knowledge of modern expense management systems (**Expensify**, Concur, or similar) and global ERP platforms (**NetSuite**, SAP, or Oracle).
* Working familiarity with India Statutory Audit requirements, CIT tax filing report preparation, and month-end journal/accrual accounting.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate policy decisions professionally and partner cross-functionally across regional borders.

**Work Arrangement** This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney, and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities for system projects from design through execution. You will work across Process, Mechanical, Electrical & Instrumentation, Structural, and Design disciplines while collaborating with customers, suppliers, procurement, manufacturing, and quality teams to deliver technically compliant, high-quality solutions on schedule.

This role provides an opportunity to apply strong engineering judgment, take ownership of project outcomes, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to continuous improvement.

**Our Team**

John Zink is a global combustion and emissions-control partner delivering engineered solutions including industrial burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor control systems, and related services.

Our team brings together multidisciplinary engineering expertise and works collaboratively with customers, suppliers, manufacturing teams, and global subject matter experts to solve complex industrial challenges safely, reliably, and efficiently.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead the technical execution of assigned projects, ensuring engineering deliverables align with contractual requirements, customer specifications, project scope, quality expectations, and schedules.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities across Process, Mechanical, Electrical & Instrumentation, Structural, and Design teams to support effective project execution.
* Develop, review, and coordinate key engineering deliverables including P&IDs, General Arrangement drawings, calculations, datasheets, specifications, material requisitions, and mechanical design packages.
* Prepare technical specifications and procurement documentation for bought-out equipment and packaged systems and conduct technical evaluations of supplier proposals.
* Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to review and approve drawings, calculations, and technical documentation while driving timely closure of technical issues.
* Partner with customers, procurement, quality, manufacturing, and other stakeholders to resolve technical queries and ensure engineering requirements are effectively implemented.
* Ensure equipment, systems, and engineering deliverables comply with applicable contractual requirements, engineering codes and standards, customer specifications, and recognized engineering practices.
* Monitor engineering performance, including quality, on-time delivery, engineering efficiency, design consistency, and technical excellence.
* Manage engineering man-hour budgets for assigned projects, monitor utilization, and identify potential scope changes or budget variances.
* Participate in project Kick-Off Meetings, progress reviews, HAZOP/SIL studies, design reviews, 3D model reviews, and other technical project discussions.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Minimum **10 years of experience** in Project Engineering and/or Package Engineering for mechanical systems, equipment, piping, or packaged systems.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities and managing multiple engineering priorities and deliverables.
* Experience preparing and reviewing engineering documentation, technical specifications, drawings, datasheets, and procurement-related technical documentation.
* Professional verbal and written communication skills in English, with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

  

* Experience with combustion equipment or emissions-control systems within the oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical, power, or process industries.
* Experience in the engineering and execution of packaged systems, process equipment, or turnkey projects in a multidisciplinary environment.
* Experience with ERP and Product Lifecycle Management systems such as **Infor LN (Baan)** for BOM management, procurement support, engineering documentation, or change management.
* Working knowledge of applicable international and regional engineering codes and standards, including **ASME, IBR, PED, API, ISO, and relevant Indian Standards (IS)**.
* Demonstrated curiosity, humility, openness to feedback, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager - India
description:
**Who we are looking for**

The Human Resources Business Partner Manager leads and facilitates all HR people programs and strategies to support the needs of their assigned line of business through collaboration with the clients, HR specialty teams and other HR business partners. This role will serve as an expert consultant to Optiv’s India entity and consult with leaders on all talent matters, including talent reviews, organizational effectiveness, leader effectiveness, change management, organizational design and career pathways.

**How you’ll make an impact**

  

* Primary strategic HR partner to the India professional services function developing people strategies, performance analytics, needs assessments and resulting HR solutions.
* Establishes and maintains an intimate understanding of the client organizations and the business, in the interest of building effective and productive working relationships with internal stakeholders and clients, at all levels of the organization.
* Guides business leaders on HR policies and processes, including talent reviews, learning and development, and performance management to promote engagement and a culture of continuous growth and development.
* Translates business strategies into people and organizational priorities. Leads the discussion with the business leadership teams in applying and aligning people and organizational priorities with organization vision and execution, to achieve the business goals for an assigned client.
* Assesses career progression and promotion criteria of the workforce, develops skills inventory by role and employee development needs based on business strategy to help close gaps between current and future skill sets.
* Plans and leads organization design projects to streamline and implement new structures, roles and/or processes that create speed, efficiency, and support rapidly shifting business demands.
* Works closely with management and employees to coach and improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Champions a return to office environment and assists with lifting onsite culture and collaboration.
* Provide guidance on people and organizational issues: Employee relations, Talent Management, Succession planning, Performance Management and HR strategic initiatives.
* Develops thoughtful, integrated approaches to promote diversity, equity and inclusion in talent attraction, development and retention.
* Plans and facilitates leader alignment sessions, new leader assimilation sessions, strategy deployment work sessions with a goal to develop business strategies (i.e. vision, mission, value, objectives) that help support organizational focus, efficiency, speed, and business results.
* Lead partner with talent acquisition, with a strong focus on acquiring and retaining top talent and on building pipeline for future needs.
* Provide HR analytics to assist leadership with the decision-making process and to understand trends on hiring, attraction, compensation, structure design, etc.
* Play an active leadership role in the commitment to continuous improvement and be perceived as credible and capable of leading organization effectiveness across the business.

**Qualifications for success**

  

* 10-12 years of experience in an HR Business Partner Role, preferably in a global company or professional services industry. This role may or may not manage a team in the future.
* Proven ability to diagnose problems using strategic hinking skills as well as identify and drive appropriate solutions.
* History of successfully delivering against people agendas.
* Demonstrated ability to work in and manage ambiguity – dealing with issues that do not always have a process or a system in place.
* Ability to position self as credible (garners respect, acts with integrity, keeps commitments); proactive (has a point of view, challenges assumptions, takes initiative); and a trusted thought partner (builds relationships, delivers results).
* Demonstrated experience and ability to balance business partnering skills with employee advocacy.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with constant change and adaptability.
* Background reflecting a strong tenure and career progression within a complex, global organization.
* Ability to lead and manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong project management skills, business acumen, Excel spreadsheet, and PowerPoint capability.
* English fluency required
* Must be able to report onsite to our Bangalore office 3 days per week.

**What you can expect from Optiv**

* A company committed to our inclusive value through our Employee Resource Groups
* Work/life balance
* Professional training resources
* Creative problem-solving and the ability to tackle unique, complex projects
* Volunteer Opportunities. “Optiv Chips In” encourages employees to volunteer and engage with their teams and communities.
* The ability and technology necessary to productively work remotely/from home (where applicable)
